CustomField.formula: IF( AND( OR( Account_Hierarchy_Sales_Region__c = 'AMER', Account_Hierarchy_Sales_Region__c = 'EMEA', Account_Hierarchy_Sales_Region__c = 'APAC', Account_Hierarchy_Sales_Region__c = 'JPN' ), Hierarchy_Employee_Count__c > 0 ), "No Action Needed", IF( AND( OR( Account_Hierarchy_Sales_Region__c = 'AMER', Account_Hierarchy_Sales_Region__c = 'EMEA', Account_Hierarchy_Sales_Region__c = 'APAC', Account_Hierarchy_Sales_Region__c = 'JPN' ), Hierarchy_Employee_Count__c = 0 ), "Missing Hierarchy Employee Count", IF( AND( Account_Hierarchy_Sales_Region__c == null, Hierarchy_Employee_Count__c > 0 ), "Missing Hierarchy Sales Region", "Missing Hierarchy Sales Region and Hierarchy Employee Count" ) ) )
